How we know

The club’s homepage and its October 2026 calendar (fetched Oct 1, 2026) list rides on most days, such as Thu Oct 1 at 5:30 pm (Tour De Maverick Social), Fri Oct 2 at 9:00 am and noon, and Sat Oct 3 at 10:00 am, and say ‘Anyone, member or not, is welcome to join any ride!’.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Rated O, B, C etc. per ride. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @bccutah the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bonneville Cycling Club Weekly Rides group ride

Bonneville Cycling Club Weekly Rides is a road group ride in Salt Lake City, UT. Schedule: Multiple rides most days of the week; see the club calendar.

Utah’s largest cycling club, with 500-plus rides a year across the Salt Lake Valley. Each listing carries a pace rating, mileage and a Ride with GPS route. Weekday evening and daytime social rides are common. Check the calendar for start points.
